bead.title: Specify and scaffold the Caravan Rust CLI
bead.description: Encode the operator's agent-in-the-loop merge-queue design in SPEC.md, critically resolve or explicitly record key semantic gaps, then scaffold a Rust `cara` CLI using the established mcp-cli, updatable-cli, and feedback-cli ecosystem patterns plus a Nix flake and baseline CI/docs. The initial executable should expose agent-friendly help and structurally register the planned command surface without pretending unimplemented queue operations work. After landing the foundation, decompose the implementation into parallel, dependency-aware beads for crvn-dev-msm-0/1/2.
bead.creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0
